definitions.gloss: very small amount; negligible quantity; trifling
definitions.explanation: An extremely small quantity or degree. Used in formal or written contexts to describe something minimal.

examples.japanese: {僅少|きんしょう}な{差|さ}で{負|ま}けた。
examples.english: I lost by a tiny margin.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}が{僅少|きんしょう}になっている。
{僅少|きんしょう}ながら{寄付|きふ}させていただきます。
examples.english: I would like to make a small donation.

notes:
{僅少|きんしょう} is a formal word meaning an extremely small amount. Common in business, news, and written contexts.

GRAMMAR:
Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective:
- {僅少|きんしょう}な{差|さ}: a tiny margin/difference
- {在庫|ざいこ}が{僅少|きんしょう}: stock is very low

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {僅少|きんしょう}ながら: though it is a small amount (humble set phrase when offering something)
- {僅少|きんしょう}な{差|さ}: a tiny margin
- {在庫|ざいこ}{僅少|きんしょう}: very limited stock (seen in product listings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {僅|わず}か: slight, a mere (more common, less formal)
- {少量|しょうりょう}: small quantity
- {微量|びりょう}: trace amount (even smaller)
- {少|すく}ない: few, little (everyday adjective)

REGISTER:
Formal/written. In everyday speech, {少|すこ}し or {僅|わず}か would be used instead.
